## Server

### Fixed

- The server's placeholder character no longer takes a player seat. A 4-slot server admitted 3 players; every slot is a player's now.
- Players are no longer put into the placeholder character's party. The first player to join leads the party (named after the server), everyone after joins them, and when the leader logs off the game hands the party to the next member. The placeholder character is in no party at all.
- The player count in the status file stayed one low after a refused join. Fixed.

## Client

No change; the package is rebuilt so both halves carry the same version.
